title: Add chunk(array, size) with validation

brief.goal: Add `chunk(items, size)` to src/collections.ts splitting an array into consecutive pieces of `size`, with the last piece shorter when needed; size < 1 or non-integer throws a RangeError; the input is not mutated.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test

expected_clean_output: chunk with RangeError validation and a shorter final piece; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: The final partial chunk is dropped: chunk([1,2,3,4,5], 2) returns [[1,2],[3,4]].
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: the result has two chunks instead of three.
